name: Agent Center: Tavern & Auto-Battler
description: A tavern per project where your agents are characters acting out their work. Just watch them, or turn on the idle auto-battler: their work becomes levels, loot and fights against 20 monster races and 55 named bosses.

cover.alt: Six project rooms in game mode: each room's party of agents fights its monster

screenshots.alt: Six project rooms in Gallery view on three themes
Game mode: each room's party fights its monster, with wave, health and stamina on top
Game mode's named bosses, each with its own fixed look
The Pixel Dark theme: a developer office with agents at their desks
The Guild Hall theme: agents by the fireplace, one with a familiar
The Gothic Dungeon theme: an agent with three familiars

commands.title: Agent Center: Show or Hide the Panel

settings.title: External view port
settings.description: Local port the external view (detached window, fullscreen, mini) is served on. 0 turns it off.

settings.title: Open to the local network
settings.description: Lets another device on the same network, such as a tablet, open the external view. No password: anyone on the network can see your agent names.

settings.title: Minutes until a finished agent leaves
settings.description: Only used when the Orca CLI is unavailable. With it, an agent leaves when its terminal closes.

settings.title: Game mode
settings.description: Turns the work your agents do into progress: levels, monsters to fight, materials and upgrades. On Orca releases without session token totals, progress is estimated from working time and tool calls. Uses real token totals from Orca's Agent Session History once Orca offers them and the session history permission is granted.

settings.title: Game mode: keep conversation titles
settings.description: Keeps a finished session's conversation title on its retired character. Off: titles are never stored, and turning it off forgets the ones kept.
